description: Source code for SecurityAgent plugin handling security tokens, ACL, and token validation within WPEFramework.

classes.name: SecurityCallsign
classes.description: Implements security interface with a callsign property for subsystem security info.

methods.name: TokenDispatcher::Tokenize::Procedure
methods.description: Handles IPC message to create security token and respond.

methods.name: SecurityAgent::SecurityAgent
methods.description: Constructor initializing security agent, registering services, and generating secret key.

methods.name: SecurityAgent::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes security agent, loads ACL, sets subsystem security, and creates token dispatcher.

methods.name: SecurityAgent::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up security agent, releases dispatcher, and resets subsystem security.

methods.name: SecurityAgent::Information
methods.description: Returns empty string, no additional info.

methods.name: SecurityAgent::CreateToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token from input buffer using SHA256 and secret key.

methods.name: SecurityAgent::Officer
methods.description: Validates token and creates security context if valid.

methods.name: SecurityAgent::Inbound
methods.description: Prepares request body with text factory element.

methods.name: SecurityAgent::Process
methods.description: Handles web requests for token creation and validation, returning appropriate responses.
